time_education.title: Why exact birth time matters
time_education.body: The Ascendant, MC and all house cusps advance roughly every 4 minutes of birth time; planets' signs barely move within a day. If you don't know the time, don't invent one: the tool will honestly hide what cannot be computed without it and show what can.
